packageRules.description: Keep the Terraform CLI version (infrastructure/.terraform-version) out of the npm non-major group; large jumps can affect state and providers, so review and merge manually
Keep the cnp-jenkins-library @Library bump in Jenkinsfiles out of the npm non-major group so pipeline changes are tested on their own
cookie v1+ is ESM-only and drops parse/serialize used by express 4, express-session and cookie-parser; upgrade alongside express 5
express 5 needs path-to-regexp v8/body-parser v2 (conflicting with resolutions pins) and wildcard route rewrites; upgrade as a planned migration
govuk-frontend 5+ moves files under dist/ (breaking gulp/Sass paths and imported tabs macro), switches JS to ES modules and brings the brand refresh; upgrade as a planned migration
express 4 needs path-to-regexp 0.1.x (0.1.12+ has the ReDoS fixes); 0.2.x is an abandoned 2014 line that breaks '*' wildcard routes and silently skips auth/guard middleware
hmcts/cmc-cookies-manager is archived and its package.json says 1.0.6 at tag 3.0.3, so Renovate reports a phantom major lockfile update that never produces a PR; nothing newer will ever be released
connect-redis 9+ only supports node-redis v5 (and 11 is ESM-only); the session store uses ioredis. Remove when the app moves to node-redis.

Hold the OpenTelemetry resolutions on the 2.x line that @azure/monitor-opentelemetry (via applicationinsights) is built on: it declares instrumentation-http ^0.221.0 (the 0.222.0 pin is already slightly ahead). instrumentation-http 0.300+ moves to @opentelemetry/core 3.x and needs @opentelemetry/api 1.10, but core 2.x peers on api <1.10.0. Raise these pins together once Azure Monitor moves to a newer OpenTelemetry line.
See the instrumentation-http rule: @azure/monitor-opentelemetry declares instrumentation-pg ^0.73.0; newer releases depend on @opentelemetry/instrumentation 0.301 and core 3.x.
See the instrumentation-http rule: @azure/monitor-opentelemetry declares instrumentation-mysql ^0.67.0; newer releases depend on @opentelemetry/instrumentation 0.301.

ESLint 9 defaults to flat config and 10 drops .eslintrc.js/.eslintignore; @typescript-eslint 5 supports ESLint 6-8 only. Upgrade as one planned migration: TypeScript, typescript-eslint, ESLint with eslint.config.js, and sass-lint replaced by stylelint (as civil-citizen-ui did in #8417).
The sass-lint/eslint resolution only feeds sass-lint 1.x, which loads eslint/lib/formatters/*; that path moved in ESLint 6 and is blocked by the exports map in 8+. Remove when sass-lint is replaced.
typescript-eslint 6+ requires TypeScript >=4.3 (8 requires >=4.8.4) and ESLint 8.56+/flat config; TypeScript is held on 3.9. See the eslint rule.
